g_policy.reason: The card is dismissible and opt-in ('Not now'). The offer copy states the reward (3 Advanced reasoning answers today). Declining leaves Home unchanged, and the 'if the ad fails' field covers both no-fill and unverified plays.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 Advanced reasoning mode answers until midnight, which is an in-app feature sample with no cash value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the first app open after 3+ days without a session by a non-subscriber. This is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal removes, locks or caps nothing free ('removes nothing free: yes'). Advanced reasoning mode is a paywall feature (s02.e03), so the sample only adds access.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits on s01 Chats home, which is rated safe, as app chrome under the header. It is not in the conversation and not over a chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor. Advanced reasoning mode is a listed paid Luzia+ feature (l02, s02.e03), so the app charges for the resource the reward gives.

c2_evidence.reason: The offer copy says 'All your past chats will be lost in 30 days if you do not upgrade'. Nothing in the product model supports a chat-deletion policy, and it is not an observed limit. The model also says no free-tier limit was observed.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is quantity-limited (3 answers) and time-limited (until midnight), with a 1 per day cap. The full feature stays behind the paid plans.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears at app open on the Home screen, on a persistent surface and is dismissible. It does not interrupt a task in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: This is a play-to-earn sponsored game. The reward state appears only after the confirmed play, and the trigger (an app open after a 3+ day gap by a non-subscriber) is detectable by the app.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names the Advanced reasoning mode paywall bullet, the Luzia+ badge on Chats home, the 'How can I help you today?' prompt card and the 3-day trial button.

other_concern: The copy's 30-day chat-loss threat is a fabricated, pressuring claim and could also read as a removal of something free. Inferred reward size is fine, but the 'Luzia+ keeps it every day' note should not overstate what the app offers.
